answer: Sybil resistance works by binding each agent identity to a scarce, costly credential, such as a bonded stake locked on-chain. To register, an agent must deposit collateral that is slashed if it duplicates identities. Like a river carving a single channel, honest agents flow through one verified path, while attackers must fund every fake account across the ridge of detection, paying full cost each time.
